title: action copy templates: a bulk param named locale sets the formatter locale of the whole confirm sentence, because the template engine reads its locale from the same extra roots
body:
Filing gate ②: a seat ruling on an out-of-scope finding. On #25942 the `domain:ui` seat 2 ruled B: the locale question goes on its own engine card and is not folded into the bulk-confirm fix. ⛔ Not a claim.

The template engine takes the locale its formatters use from `ctx.extra.locale` (`packages/formula/src/template-engine.ts:276`). The console's action-copy filler passes the template's roots in that same `extra` object (`ui/packages/core/src/actions/actionCopyTemplate.ts:82`, `templateEngine.evaluate({ dialect: 'template', source }, { extra: roots })`). Since #25942, a bulk action's params are template roots. So a param named `locale` silently sets the formatter locale of the whole confirm sentence. When there is no such param, formatters render in `en-US` rather than the viewer's language.

**Business reason.** A bulk confirm sentence such as "Set the region to {{ region }} on {{ count }} records" formats its numbers and dates in en-US for a Chinese viewer. A param that happens to be called `locale` (a plausible field on any localization object) changes how every formatted value in the sentence renders.

**Who acts.** Whoever owns `@objectstack/formula`'s template evaluation context. The likely shape is a dedicated locale slot on the evaluate context, kept apart from the author-visible roots, which the console's filler passes from the display locale. The renderer side is `fillTemplateHoles` in `ui/packages/core`. Triage sets domain and route.

**Found by.** The os-dev report on #25942 (comment 6420654854, step 2 / PR #26217), out_of_scope_findings.

**Duplicate check.** Searched for "template engine extra locale", "formatter locale hijack" and "fillTemplateHoles locale" in the 40 newest issues. 0 hits.
